services.name: Adult Tours
services.desc: Unleash your creativity with the Tampa Museum of Art’s fun vitality arts program series called Studio 55! Funded by E.A. Michelson Philanthropy, these programs offer a unique opportunity for adults 55 years of age and older to learn new art-making techniques, gain a sense of accomplishment, and forge new relationships. Led by teaching artists, these multi-session, hands-on workshops are designed to improve health and well-being and provide a renewed sense of purpose for participants. We have also created a Studio 55 Facebook group to encourage engagement outside of the classroom with our online community. Loneliness and isolation are negatively affecting the health of many older adults.

services.name: Student Exhibition
services.desc: The Tampa Museum of Art’s permanent collection includes a growing collection of art from the Caribbean and holds work by several of Cuba and Haiti’s most influential artists of the 20th and 21st centuries. The Haitian collection is especially robust with over 150 Vodou sequin flags and nearly 100 paintings. Today, it is regarded as one of the largest public collections of Haitian modern art in Florida and across the United States. Colorful landscapes and powerful portraits of deities comprise the Haitian painting collection.
